items.title: Ukraine: Oleshky residents evacuate war-ravaged city
items.excerpt: Under the local ceasefire, an aid convoy of 25 buses arrived with humanitarian aid and as transport for fleeing Oleshky residents. The Ukrainian city has been occupied by Russia since 2022 and faces food shortages.
